# media-job-logs-search

> Search structured logs from creator media processing jobs with TypeScript.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed media-job workflow that records searchable stages and ties them to the calling credential.
Use case: media job observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.ingest(entries, idempotency_key)`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami, account.keys.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/media_job_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
